zh-CN.title: 气泡预览更真实
items: 气泡预览覆盖文字、图片、语音、视频与各类卡片
结构化消息现在也会继承气泡外框和分组圆角
预览可直接查看消息发送中的走马灯效果

en.title: A more realistic bubble preview
items: Bubble previews now cover text, media, and every card type
Structured messages inherit bubble borders and grouped corners
The preview now demonstrates the sending sheen effect
